hook: An AI video editor you can run from Claude or ChatGPT 🎞️
summary: ClipTalk is an AI video editor that plans, scripts, creates and edits short vertical videos from an idea, script, article or link. Its MCP server (24 tools) lets you make and edit videos from Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor and other AI assistants.
points: Free sign-up with 50 trial credits, no card
Basic $19/mo (3,000 credits), Pro $39/mo with API + full MCP
Captions, silence removal and auto-editing don't use credits
caveat: Free videos carry a watermark and no refund policy is published.
